title: MZ Your Average RPG Maker Game (Horror)

posts.author: Buuboo
posts.body:
​
​
Your Average RPG Maker Game is, what you, the player. expect it to be, an average rpg maker game.​
Story :​
You play as Reid, and his 2 friends, “Priscilla, and Roza”​
After a tragic fall during one of your adventures, you awaken in an unknown, mysterious cave that no one has explored in a long time.​
You must find your way out and discover the mysteries of this cave.​
Will you escape, or will you be doomed to the endless darkness?​
​
Manage your inventory :​
Limited space, manage your inventory using containers in each safe zone, but be careful, you can't drop everything.​
​
Cave backstory :​
During a work collaboration with a team of miners to dig out a nearby cave for storage and other things, things go horribly wrong as some sort of unknown, mysterious disease is found, slowly murdering everyone in it's path, the project had to be cancelled because "Ozias" the main chief was in trouble from the disease, and he didn't want to risk the worker's life.​
​
Characters (Excluding the main party/Lore Wise) :
​
​
Ozias : The chief of this excavation project, a kind-hearted soul devoted to help his workers out during work time. He knows what he's doing​
​
Full name : Ozias Vell :​
Age : 26​
5'11​
​
Personality :​
- Patient​
- Protective​
- Observant​
​
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------​
​
Lume : One of the main excavation workers, the player follows the backstory through his eyes, Ozias himself hired Lume while at job offers.​
​
Full name : Lume Irel​
Age : 20​
5'8​
​
Personality :​
- Hopeful​
- Self Contained.​
- Pretty Introverted around new people.​
